_meta.about: Baseline (fixed-calendar) irrigation schedules for the replay, written from published recommendations so the baseline is not a strawman. Day numbers count from sowing / transplanting / planting (day 1).
_meta.how_to_run: Simulate the same weather twice: (1) apply the baseline events below to the water balance, (2) let the Boond rules decide. Compare total water, kWh, CO2e, number of irrigations and stress days (Ks < 1).
_meta.pre_sowing: Pre-sowing irrigation is the same in both runs; do not count it as a saving.

wheat.source: Punjab Agricultural University, Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab - Rabi 2025-26, p.17 (https://pau.edu/content/ccil/pf/pp_rabi.pdf)
wheat.applies_to_soils: sandy loam or heavier (PAU says advance the first irrigation on light soils)

first_irrigation._depth_note: PAU: 'relatively light'. 50 mm is an ASSUMPTION; say so on the validation screen.

wheat._weeks_note: PAU gives 5-6 and 3-4 week ranges; mid-points used (ASSUMPTION). Intervals may move 2-3 days either way.

rain_rule._note: PAU: for each cm of rain, extend the next interval by 5 days up to end of January and by 2 days after that. Applying this makes the baseline fair.
rain_rule._note_cap: ASSUMPTION: at most 75 mm of rain (one PAU irrigation of 7.5 cm) is credited per interval. Without a cap, the record January 2022 rain (~119 mm at Ludhiana) delays the next irrigation by ~60 days and the baseline skips almost every irrigation.

paddy.source: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab - Kharif 2026, p.12 (https://pau.edu/content/ccil/pf/pp_kharif.pdf)
paddy.then: irrigate 2 days after the ponded water has infiltrated
paddy._note: The PAU schedule depends on the pond, so the baseline must be simulated with the paddy pond model (see DATA_GUIDE). 75 mm per irrigation is an ASSUMPTION. An alternative 'common farmer practice' baseline is continuous flooding to maturity; if you use it, label it clearly as farmer practice, not PAU advice.

cotton.source: Approved Package of Practices for Cotton, Punjab State (CICR, compiled by M. Sabesh, 2006-07) and PAU Kharif 2026 (first irrigation 35-40 DAS)
cotton._rain_reset_note: ASSUMPTION: a day with >= 25 mm rain restarts the interval count (the published schedule says 4-6 irrigations 'depending on seasonal rainfall' without a numeric rule).

sugarcane.source: PAU Farm Operations for April and June (7-12 day interval); TNAU Agritech Sugarcane Expert System (10-15 days summer, 25-30 days winter)
sugarcane._interval_note: Apr-Jun 10 d = mid of PAU's 7-12 d. Monsoon (Jul-Sep) 15 d plus rain reset and Oct-Jan 20-30 d are ASSUMPTIONS based on TNAU's summer/winter ranges.
sugarcane._first_note: TNAU: first irrigation when 20-25% of setts have germinated, or ~20 days after planting.
